OCNL: Occasional or occasionally; used to indicate intermittent occurrence of a condition
OCS: Obstacle clearance surface; a defined surface used in obstacle assessment for instrument approach procedures
OCT: October; abbreviation for the tenth month
OHM: Off-helmets; refers to sport aviation operations conducted without flight helmet
OIS: Obstacle identification surface; a surface used to identify obstacles that must be considered for terrain clearance
OLR: Outer locator; a non-directional beacon (NDB) serving as the outer marker locator at an ILS installation
OMA: Outer marker to MAPI; segment from outer marker to missed approach point initiation
OMG: Outer marker to glidepath; reference point for approach procedure design using DME arc or R-NAV
OMI: OMI (VOR, ILS); indicates the use of Omni-bearing selector or OBS for VOR and ILS course guidance
OMT: OMT (AIP amendments); indicates amendments or corrections published for the AIP
OMV: OMV (visual, VFR); indicates operations conducted under visual flight rules or visual meteorological conditions
OPR: Operate or operator or operative; refers to the entity or status of a facility being in service
OPS: Operations; refers to flight operations or operational activities
ORIG: Original; indicates the first issuance of a document or NOTAM
O/R: On request; indicates that a service or clearance is provided only when specifically requested
OSN: Offset speed negotiation; a process for agreeing on speed adjustments in offset flight paths
OTA: Outer transfer area; a designated area for transferring aircraft control between ATC sectors or facilities
OTH: Other; used to indicate items not covered by other categories
OUBD: Outbound; refers to traffic departing from a location or proceeding away from a reference point
OVHD: Overhead; indicates a position directly above a reference point or an overhead approach maneuver
PALS: Precision approach lighting system; a standardized lighting system providing visual guidance to the runway for precision approaches
PAR: Precision approach radar; a radar system providing precision guidance to aircraft during final approach
PARL: Parallel; describes runways or routes that are aligned in the same direction
PBD: PBN box designator; a designated area or box defined by Performance Based Navigation criteria
PBN: Performance-based navigation; area navigation based on performance requirements for aircraft operating in an airspace
PCD: Proceed or proceeding; instruction to continue along a route or as directed
PCM: Pulse code modulation; a digital encoding method used in aviation communications and data transmission
PDG: Procedure design gradient; the minimum climb gradient required for a departure or missed approach procedure
PDI: Pilot direction indicator; a device providing directional guidance to the pilot
PEC: Permanent echo centre; the centre of a permanent radar echo used as a reference point
PEL: Panel; refers to a control panel or instrument panel in the cockpit
PER: Period; indicates a specified duration or time interval
PFC: Pavement friction coefficient; a measure of the skid resistance of runway or taxiway pavement surfaces
PJE: Parachute jumping exercise; a training activity involving parachute jumps
PLA: Practice low approach; a training approach at low altitude without landing
PLVL: Present level; the current altitude or flight level of an aircraft
PM: Pilot-interpreted and monitoring; a mode of operation where the pilot interprets and monitors aircraft systems
PN: Prior notice required; indicates that advance notification is needed for a service or action
PNA: Prior notice to authorities; indicates that authorities must be notified in advance
PNL: Panel; refers to a display panel or information board, such as a notice panel
POB: Persons on board; the total number of people aboard an aircraft
PPR: Prior permission required; indicates that advance authorization is mandatory for a service or action
PPSN: Present position; the current geographic position of an aircraft
PRA: Precision runway approach; an approach procedure providing precision guidance to a runway
PRD: Period; indicates a specified duration or time interval (variant of PER)
PRKG: Parking; refers to the parking of aircraft at a stand, gate, or apron
PRM: Prime; indicates the primary or most significant item in a sequence
PROC: Procedure; a defined sequence of actions or maneuvers in aviation operations
PRP: Platform relative performance; performance metrics relative to a specific platform or aircraft type
PRV: Previous or previously; indicates something that occurred earlier or a prior state
PS: Plus; indicates an additional amount or a positive value
